Gut-Healing Golden Milk | Recipe and Benefits | Dr. Hansaji
Golden milk, or haldi ka doodh, has been part of Indian food and traditional health practices for generations. Made with turmeric, ginger, black pepper, milk and a little ghee, this warm drink has now become popular around the world.
